C9000170.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 170 (Sharp logarithmic exponents for off-diagonal Ramsey numbers.; papers: The sharp logarithmic exponent of r(5,t); Sharp logarithmic exponents for fixed off-diagonal Ramsey numbers; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/170.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

PC_CORE_AUDIT.statement: Independently checked verification of the dimension-three conditional high-moment implication, or an exact admissible refutation; no claim about the full Ramsey construction.

PC_HM.statement: For every prepared dimension-three input outside D0 union D1 union D2 and every positive-probability own-cell schedule, E[(T_x^*)^p | O_x] <= B^p exp(-pP/10), for all sufficiently large prime q.

PC_MIXED.statement: Mixed centered Poisson emptiness moments use unions indexed by tuple positions, with repetitions retained; own-cell conditioning preserves the independent line-batch law.

PC_COMPONENT.statement: External-schedule conditioning gives nonsimple attenuation exp(-.7P) and simple attenuation exp(-.68P)(|delta|^(R/2)+(p theta_max)^200+1_B).

PC_STATIC.statement: Every simultaneous residual hit event has an anchor/pair/root certificate charging distinct direction-batch events only once, with a dictionary of O(p) directions.

PC_COUNT.statement: The positive weighted sum of static certificates and component choices has only exp(o(pP)) overhead after normalization by B^p and the stated attenuation savings.

PC_SCALES.statement: The manuscript scales make all explicit finite moment-theorem numerical hypotheses hold uniformly in the allowed D interval as q tends to infinity.

PC_PREPARATION.statement: The preceding geometric preparation and regular-pencil estimates actually supply all input inequalities used by the learning section.

PC_CONSTRUCTION.statement: Short-row implementation, marking, context replacement, entropy, decoding and iteration establish the claimed full Ramsey lower construction.

PC_FIXED_MAIN.statement: For each fixed s >= 6 and epsilon > 0, r(s,t) >= t^(s-1)/(log t)^(s-2+epsilon) for all sufficiently large t, as asserted in intro:main.

PC_COMPANION_HM.statement: The companion ambient-high-moment estimate includes its high-case truncation event and allows an own-cell union of mass at most .08; it is not identical to the untruncated fixed-off-diagonal assertion.

PC_LINEAR_HM.statement: The finite-parameter linear-incidence theorem in report.md bounds E T^p by B^p A^(1000p) exp(-17pP/50) for all finite linear block systems satisfying its explicit hypotheses, with arbitrary deterministic gates.

PC_FORMAL_CORE.statement: Universal exact finite mixed-moment recursion for lists with repetitions, positive weighted-pair enlargement, and affine root/component/exponent inequalities. This is not a formalization of the full high-moment theorem.
